requirements.title: Bounded Context Retrieval
requirements.detail: Retrieves top 15 nearest + top 3 per gap + 10 diverse sample (capped at ~40 items) to prevent context window explosion.

requirements.title: Coverage-Aware Generation
requirements.detail: Identifies curriculum subtopics, computes existing bank density, and directs generation toward uncovered gaps.

requirements.title: Independent Duplicate Detector
requirements.detail: Decoupled standalone detector (POST /api/check) operating independently from generation prompt instructions.

requirements.title: Multi-Stage Detection Pipeline
requirements.detail: Stage 1: NFKC Normalized Hash -> Stage 2: FastEmbed Cosine Similarity -> Stage 3: LLM Judge with Safe Fallback.

requirements.title: Hard-Negative & Numeric Safeguards
requirements.detail: Questions with differing numerical values (e.g. 30° vs 45°) are prevented from auto-merging regardless of embedding score.

requirements.title: Tag-Agnostic Deduplication
requirements.detail: Metadata tags (subject, topic, bloom_level) are purely for filtering and never influence duplicate decisions.

requirements.title: Batch Deduplication & In-Batch Validation
requirements.detail: Batch endpoint (POST /api/check/batch) audits lists; newly accepted candidates immediately join the comparison index.

requirements.title: Empirical Evaluation Benchmark
requirements.detail: Quantitative benchmark on reflection corpus (89% accuracy, 100% duplicate precision/recall) with confusion matrix.
